subject: Request: Temporary adjustment to P1/P2 response windows during Q2 rollout
messages:
From: Carla Rios <carla.rios@finallabs.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: ops@finallabs.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary SLA window for P1/P2 during Q2 rollout

Hi Ben,

Quick ask from our side as we enter a phased rollout next week. Our operations team will run staggered migrations across EU and APAC datacenters over the next 10 days. That schedule will create a short period where our on-call engineers will be split between incident response for our environment and coordinating the migration — we anticipate a 36-48 hour window where our ability to engage for playbook-driven troubleshooting is reduced.

Specifically, we need Redwood to approve a temporary relaxation of our Support Response Time SLA for this window:
- P1 (production-down): increase from 1 hour to 4 hours
- P2 (degraded but partial functionality): increase from 8 hours to 12 hours

We understand this is an exception request and are prepared to:
- Provide a daily status bridge and a named escalation contact (Carla Rios)
- Accept a limited one-week exception starting 2027-04-13 08:00 UTC
- Share the migration runbook attached (finallabs-rollout-plan.pdf)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can sign off on a temporary deviation and, if so, what the internal approval/escalation path will look like? We need confirmation by EOD Friday to lock scheduling.

Thanks — appreciate the speedy help.

Best,
Carla Rios
Head of Cloud Ops, FinalLabs
carla.rios@finallabs.com
+1 415 555 0199

Attachment: finallabs-rollout-plan.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

Thanks Ben and Carla — flagged for leadership. A couple of quick internal asks before we agree to a temporary SLA deviation:

1) Compensation or credit: if we increase allowable response windows we should capture whether FinalLabs expects credits for impacted windows. We need to be explicit in the exception doc.
2) Escalation anchor: who is the Redwood single point of contact during this window (we should provide a named senior engineer and an escalation to our paging manager).
3) Auto-fallback policy: proposal from Product/Eng that if errors increase above X% (we should define X) we automatically route requests to the previous stable model variant *without* counting that as a Redwood failure. Carla, can you confirm whether FinalLabs is OK with that behavior?

I don’t want us to approve anything that sets a precedent without sign-off from Legal/RevOps, so Ben — please route the final exception summary to me and cc: legal@redwood.com; I’ll fast-track through leadership once the plan is clear.

- Window covered: 2027-04-13 08:00 UTC -> 2027-04-20 08:00 UTC (7 days)
- P1 response target for exception period: 4 hours (primary contact + backup)
- P2 response target: 12 hours
- On-call adjustments: extend US east coverage by +2 hours each day and bring an additional EMEA backup on a shadow pager to pick up any overflow.

Subject: Re: Temporary SLA window for P1/P2 during Q2 rollout

Carla — thanks again for the runbook. Based on internal review here’s the proposed exception package for FinalLabs: 

1) Exception window: 2027-04-13 08:00 UTC -> 2027-04-20 08:00 UTC (7 days)
2) Adjusted response times (temporary): P1 = 4 hours; P2 = 12 hours
3) Coverage & escalation: Redwood will implement the rota attached (temp-rota.csv). Primary pager then backup, then Karthik, then Marissa. Daily 30-minute bridge at 09:00 UTC weekdays.
4) Auto-fallback: If error rate (5xx) increases by >2x baseline for more than 15 minutes we will trigger an automatic fallback to the most recent stable model variant; that fallback will be documented and explicitly excluded from SLA failure calculations for the exception window.
5) Credits: No blanket credit — credits considered only if an extended outage (P0 equivalent) is incurred and accepted by both parties. Any credit needs RevOps sign-off after the exception period.
6) Legal amendment: We will produce a short appendix amendment for signature (one-page) capturing the timebox and guardrails. Legal (cc’d) will send the DocuSign link once FinalLabs confirms.

Please confirm acceptance of 1–6 and if you’re good we’ll dispatch the amendment and schedule the first daily bridge for 2027-04-13 09:00 UTC.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
